### CVE-2016-1960
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2016-03-13 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 44294: Firefox 44.0.2 - ASM.JS JIT-Spray Remote Code Execution (remote/windows, 2018-03-16, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 42484: Mozilla Firefox < 45.0 - 'nsHtml5TreeBuilder' Use-After-Free (EMET 5.52 Bypass) (remote/windows, 2017-08-18, verified=0)

Integer underflow in the nsHtml5TreeBuilder class in the HTML5 string parser in Mozilla Firefox before 45.0 and Firefox ESR 38.x before 38.7 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service (use-after-free) by leveraging mishandling of end tags, as demonstrated by incorrect SVG processing, aka ZDI-CAN-3545.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2016-2819
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2016-06-13 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 44293: Firefox 46.0.1 - ASM.JS JIT-Spray Remote Code Execution (remote/windows, 2018-03-16, verified=1)

Heap-based buffer overflow in Mozilla Firefox before 47.0 and Firefox ESR 45.x before 45.2 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via foreign-context HTML5 fragments, as demonstrated by fragments within an SVG element.

### CVE-2016-9079
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2018-06-11 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: Use-after-free in SVG Animation; CWE-416 CWE-416 Use After Free
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial
- **CISA KEV**: added 2023-06-22, ransomware=Unknown — Mozilla Firefox, Firefox ESR, and Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 42327: Firefox 50.0.1 - ASM.JS JIT-Spray Remote Code Execution (remote/windows, 2017-07-14, verified=0)
- Exploit-DB 41151: Mozilla Firefox < 50.0.2 - 'nsSMILTimeContainer::NotifyTimeChange()' Remote Code Execution (Metasploit) (remote/windows, 2017-01-24, verified=1)

A use-after-free vulnerability in SVG Animation has been discovered. An exploit built on this vulnerability has been discovered in the wild targeting Firefox and Tor Browser users on Windows. This vulnerability affects Firefox < 50.0.2, Firefox ESR < 45.5.1, and Thunderbird < 45.5.1.

Affected:
- Mozilla / Firefox: affected unspecified <50.0.2 (custom)
- Mozilla / Firefox ESR: affected unspecified <45.5.1 (custom)
- Mozilla / Thunderbird: affected unspecified <45.5.1 (custom)
